## File: facebookresearch_egg/egg/zoo/mnist_vae/train.py

Prompts

```
['run the MNIST VAE training loop with sender and receiver networks for a specified number of epochs', 'create a Sender neural network module that encodes 784-dim MNIST images into mu and logvar latent variables', 'create a Receiver neural network module that decodes latent messages back into 784-dim reconstructed MNIST images', 'build a VAE_Game module combining Sender and Receiver with reparameterization trick and BCE plus KLD loss', 'review the ImageDumpCallback class that saves reconstructed MNIST images alongside originals at each epoch end']
```

```

```
